ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Fungal Soil Trade
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FUNGAL_SOIL_TRADE_1 (infrastructure/state/items/FUNGAL_SOIL_TRADE_1.md, owner 2026-09-06 Badlands sitting). The Rot's (AB_MycoticJungle) mycelial mat can be dug for "fungal soil" (RUT_FungalSoil), a haulable, sellable resource - an early-game income route for a Jawa clan with a gravship to cover the long haul to the Moisture Farmers (the_cracked_lands.md section 8, OutlanderCivil). Digging is capped per map (discrete mineable knots scattered only on Rot maps, no regrowth, no craft recipe - a fixed yield ceiling, never an infinite loop) and it is not free: the Rot's connected fungal network (the_rot.md section 4, health-sharing) feels the tear and sends its own hybrid fauna (Alpha Animals' AA_Agaripawn/AA_Agaripod/AA_Wildpawn/AA_Wildpod/AA_Swarmling/ AA_MycoidColossus, all confirmed live on AB_MycoticJungle via src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/BiomeCast_Ashkarr.xml and design/Jawa/fauna/animal_census.csv - never invented) at the dig site as a manhunter response, scaling with how much has been torn out and decaying if the diggers stop.
Ships: RUT_MineableFungalGround (a mineable rock knot, mined with the vanilla Mine job - no new job system), RUT_FungalSoil (the resource it yields), a biome-gated GenStep that scatters knots only on AB_MycoticJungle maps, a MapComponent + one Harmony patch on Mineable.DestroyMined that tracks dig distress and calls in the response, and RUT_FungalSoilTradeRequest (a QuestScriptDef built on vanilla's own QuestNode_TradeRequest_Initiate/TradeRequestComp - the same system Core's own TradeRequest quest uses - naming RUT_FungalSoil explicitly rather than the vanilla random-thing picker, which requires player-craftable goods and would never select a mined-only resource).
Open question this pass could not close without guessing: no Moisture Farmer FactionDef or placed settlement exists yet (StructureInjectionsRUT's TileMutatorDefs_MoistureFarm.xml is unplaced), so the trade request is not gated to OutlanderCivil specifically and no faction-specific price premium was built - both ride whichever item eventually places Moisture Farmer settlements on the world.
